Where every input came from and how every result was produced.

## Data sources

## Software environment

The Python environment is pinned by `uv.lock`, and the Python version by
`.python-version`. Record any tool not managed by uv here, with its version.

For each table and figure in `results/`, record the code that produces it
and the inputs it reads.

| ------ | ----------- | ------ |
